headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 19, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets continued their winning streak with a 9-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, led by Nolan McLean's impressive 7.0 innings pitched with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. The Kansas City Royals also secured a win, defeating the Washington Nationals 6-2 behind Luinder Avila's 5.2 innings pitched with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with 4 hits, including a home run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups and rotations. The Chicago White Sox placed RF Everson Pereira on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. The Kansas City Royals also placed LHP Cole Ragans on the 60-day injured list with left elbow impingement. Other teams with injured players include the Atlanta Braves, Cleveland Guardians, Toronto Blue Jays, Detroit Tigers, Seattle Mariners, and Chicago Cubs.

The MLB trade market saw several moves, including the Seattle Mariners trading RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays traded C Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash, while the Kansas City Royals traded RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold. The Seattle Mariners also traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Reds 9-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-1 victory. Nolan McLean led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Nationals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Luinder Avila earning the win after pitching 5.2 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with 4 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Phillies 12-4**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 12-4 victory. Kyle Stowers led the Marlins' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Braves in 7-2 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a 7-2 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Jung Hoo Lee leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Robbie Ray earned the win with 6.1 innings of scoreless relief, striking out eight batters.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a strong performance from their pitching staff and key contributions from several impact hitters. Trey Yesavage led the way for the Blue Jays' pitching, while George Springer and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. were among the standout hitters.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Brewers 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 4-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Guardians included Travis Bazzana, David Fry, Brayan Rocchio, and Kyle Manzardo, while Parker Messick was a standout pitcher.

top_news.title: **White Sox Place Everson Pereira on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Everson Pereira, the Chicago White Sox right fielder, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Mariners Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash on June 17, 2026.
